summary: Visual-only regression test of public landing page ('/'). Verified the primary bug fix: no USP cards render faded once scrolled into view. All 6 cards (including 'Undercover-Safe Privacy' and 'Department Job Board') reach opacity=1 with the 'in' class. Scroll-reveal works across all 19 .reveal elements. Category tiles have shadow, story hover scales the ring + adds shadow, spacing pull-tight→pull-up is tight (gap=0px, no overlap). CTAs navigate to /register. No page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: IntersectionObserver reveal implementation is correct and disconnects after first reveal (stays visible) — resolves prior framer-motion whileInView stuck-opacity issue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page visual polish verified on desktop (1920x900) and mobile (430x900). Desktop: all 6 USP .reveal cards opacity=1, all 19 .reveal elements gain 'in' class after scroll. Cat tiles (4) have box-shadow rgba(11,31,66,0.55) 0px 10px 24px -18px. Story hover ring transform matrix(1.06,...) + shadow applied. pull-tight/pull-up gap=0px. Both CTAs (landing-join-btn, hero-join-btn) route to /register. Only console noise: 4x 401 from unauthenticated /api/me polls — expected on public route. Mobile check: cards not yet in viewport read 0 opacity (IntersectionObserver working as intended); when scrolled to, they render opaque (visible in screenshot).
rca of the issue: Original bug: per-card framer-motion whileInView left some USP cards stuck at low opacity mid-scroll. Fix (already applied by main agent) replaces this with an IntersectionObserver-based <Reveal> that adds 'in' class once, then disconnects — guaranteeing cards remain fully visible after first reveal. Confirmed working.
